Post Date: 2024-11-01T21:45:03Z

Title: How to force ClickHouse to return column names prefixed with table names when INNER JOIN?
Description: ### Company or project name

_No response_

### Question

For example:

CREATE TABLE ta
(
    `a` UInt32,
    `id` UInt32
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE tb
(
    `b` UInt32,
    `id` UInt32
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY id

insert into ta(*) VALUES (0,1)
insert into tb(*) VALUES (1,1)

WITH
    a AS
    (
        SELECT
            a,
            id
        FROM ta
    ),
    b AS
    (
        SELECT
            b,
            id
        FROM tb
    )
SELECT *
FROM a
INNER JOIN b ON a.id = b.id

This returns
┌─a─┬─id─┬─b─┬─b.id─┐
│ 0     │  1    │ 1     │    1 │
└───┴────┴───┴──────┘

How to force the returned qualified column names, i.e. a.a, a.id, b.b and b.id?
